era: Upper Paleolithic / Gravettian Horizon & Beringian Standstill (LGM Onset)

overview.summary_fr: Reconstitution cartographique et tensorielle globale de la Terre pour l'époque -25 000 BP. Cette période correspond à l'apogée de la culture gravettienne en Eurasie (statuettes de Vénus, architectures en os de mammouth de Kostenki et Pavlov, parures complexes de Sungir), à la disparition complète des Néandertaliens, et à la phase du 'Beringian Standstill' où la population ancestrale des Amérindiens s'isole dans le refuge béringien non englacé entre la Sibérie et les inlandsis laurentidien et cordillérien. Les Amériques au sud des calottes glaciaires restent rigoureusement inhabitées.
overview.summary_en: Global cartographic and tensor reconstruction for the -25,000 BP epoch. Represents the peak of the Gravettian technocomplex in Eurasia (Venus figurines, mammoth bone architecture at Kostenki/Pavlov, tailored garments at Sungir), the complete extinction of Neanderthals, and the 'Beringian Standstill' phase where proto-Native American ancestral lineages become isolated in unglaciated Beringia. The Americas south of the continental ice sheets remain strictly uninhabited.

data_sources: GEBCO 2023 Grid Bathymetric and Topographic Model

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.paleotopographic_features: Beringia land bridge fully exposed (>1000 km wide); Sundaland and Sahul shelves broadly exposed; English Channel dry.

elevation.reconstitution_rationale: Eustatic sea level drop of -115m exposing the massive Bering land bridge connecting Chukotka to Alaska.

data_sources: Ray & Adams (2001) 'Global Physical and Biome Maps of the Last Glacial Maximum'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.continental_ice_sheets: Laurentide, Cordilleran, and Fennoscandian ice sheets covering North America and Northern Europe
scientific_parameters_and_corrections.mammoth_steppe: Vast hyper-arid cold steppe-tundra with Artemisia and Poaceae supporting large megafaunal herds

biomes.reconstitution_rationale: Severe cold and aridity converting mid-latitude forests into open steppe-tundra biomes.

data_sources: EPICA Dome C Antarctic Ice Core
MARGO Project (2009) Glacial Sea Surface Temperature Reconstruction
temperature.reconstitution_rationale: Global mean temperature ~5°C colder than modern pre-industrial levels, with severe polar amplification.

data_sources: Dust and Aerosol Fluxes in EPICA and Greenland Ice Cores
Global Speleothem and Lake Level Database

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.monsoon_weakening: Suppression of African and Asian summer monsoons, desert expansion

precipitation.reconstitution_rationale: High dust loading and widespread continental desiccation.

seasonality.reconstitution_rationale: Pronounced winter freezing and short, intense continental summers.

data_sources: Tallavaara et al. (2015) 'Human Carrying Capacity during the Gravettian'
Llamas et al. (2016) 'Ancient Mitochondrial DNA and the Beringian Standstill'
Raghavan et al. (2014) 'Upper Palaeolithic Siberian Genome from Mal'ta'

strict_uninhabited_regions: North America south of Laurentide ice sheet

density.reconstitution_rationale: Demographic contraction into southern European refuges and low-density mammoth-hunting camps in Central Europe/Russia; isolated population in Beringia.

data_sources: Greenberg et al. (1986) Proto-Amerind/Beringian Linguistic Root Modeling

clades_separated: Gravettian Central & Western European Dialect Network
Eastern European / Siberian Mammoth Hunters (Kostenki-Mal'ta Lineage)
Proto-Beringian Standstill Linguistic Lineage (Ancestral to First Americans)

isogloss.reconstitution_rationale: Emergence of the distinct Proto-Beringian linguistic stock isolated by ice sheets from Eurasia and unglaciated America.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.gravettian_aggregation_camps: Seasonal aggregation sites with up to 100-200 individuals (Dolní Věstonice, Pavlov)

sovereignty.reconstitution_rationale: Semi-sedentary mammoth-hunting band networks with winter long-houses.

data_sources: Sikora et al. (2017) 'Ancient Genomes Show Social and Reproductive Behavior of Early Upper Paleolithic Foragers at Sunghir'

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.kinship_structure: Exogamous band networks with strict taboo against close-kin inbreeding (confirmed by Sunghir aDNA)

kinship.reconstitution_rationale: Genetically proven exogamous mating networks with low inbreeding across Gravettian Europe.

data_sources: Willendorf, Lespugue, Dolní Věstonice, Brassempouy Venus Figurines
Sunghir Elaborate Mammoth Ivory Bead Burials

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.female_fertility_figurines_and_ceramic_b: World's earliest ceramic technology (baked clay figurines at Dolní Věstonice)

rituals.reconstitution_rationale: Unprecedented pan-European symbolic cohesion and rich ivory bead burial rituals.

data_sources: Svoboda (2004) 'The Gravettian on the Middle Danube'

technological_innovations: Eyed bone needles and tailored thermal fur clothing
Woven plant fiber textiles and basketry

technology.reconstitution_rationale: Advanced cold-adaptation technologies enabling permanent winter habitation of periglacial Siberia and Central Europe.

institutional.reconstitution_rationale: Egalitarian bands with ritual and hunting prestige hierarchy.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.megafaunal_harvesting: Targeted predation on Mammuthus primigenius and Coelodonta antiquitatis

ecological.reconstitution_rationale: High local biomass harvesting at mammoth kill and processing sites.

scientific_parameters_and_corrections.arctic_parasite_load: Extremely low bacterial/viral vector load in permafrost zones

pathogen.reconstitution_rationale: Freezing winter temperatures suppress insect and water-borne pathogens in the northern hemisphere.

data_sources: Féblot-Augustins (1997) 'La circulation des matières premières au Paléolithique'
tradenetwork.reconstitution_rationale: Continental-scale raw material transfers across >500 km indicating formalized alliance networks.

coal.reconstitution_rationale: 100% untouched coal reserves (early lignite burning at Dolní Věstonice).

precious_metals.reconstitution_rationale: Intact alluvial placer gold and silver beds.
